name: accounting-software
description: AI-first, source-available double-entry accounting for SMB to enterprise.
//license: FSL-1.1-ALv2. Not an SPDX identifier, so npm's convention is the SEE LICENSE IN form.

scripts.//db:roles: Compose applies schema.sql on first boot but not roles.sql, which needs a password. This creates the nl_query role with a dev-only secret so db:verify can exercise it.
scripts.db:roles: docker compose -f apps/server/docker-compose.yml exec -T db psql -U accounting -d accounting -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -v nl_query_password="'changeme-dev-only'" -f /db/roles.sql
scripts.db:verify: npm run db:roles && docker compose -f apps/server/docker-compose.yml exec -T db psql -U accounting -d accounting -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f /db/verify_schema.sql && docker compose -f apps/server/docker-compose.yml exec -T db psql -U accounting -d accounting -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f /db/verify_roles.sql
scripts.//db:local: Non-Docker path against any running Postgres. Set DATABASE_URL first.
scripts.db:apply: psql "$DATABASE_URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f db/schema.sql && psql "$DATABASE_URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -v nl_query_password="'${NL_QUERY_PASSWORD:-changeme-dev-only}'" -f db/roles.sql
scripts.db:verify:local: psql "$DATABASE_URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f db/verify_schema.sql && psql "$DATABASE_URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f db/verify_roles.sql
scripts.api:install: pip install -e packages/ai && pip install -e packages/api[dev]
